workspace.localLabel: Where the collection is stored when no folder is open.
workspace.localHint: Tooltip explaining where the collection is stored.
workspace.browserLabel: Same as above in the web app.
workspace.restrictedHint: Tooltip of the folder button while the opened folder is not trusted.
workspace.trusted: Notice after the user chose to trust a folder.
workspace.restrictedOpened: Notice after opening a folder that came from someone else. Keep "Trust this folder", it is a menu item name (workspace.trust).
workspace.switcherLabel: Accessible label of the button that opens the list of workspaces. A workspace is a folder on disk that holds a collection.
workspace.pinned: Heading of workspaces kept at the top of the list.
workspace.current: Marks the workspace that is open now.
workspace.missing: Shown for a listed folder that no longer exists on disk.
workspace.thisComputer: Entry that leaves the folder and uses the app storage on this computer.
workspace.reload: Menu item that reads the files again from disk.
workspace.close: Menu item that closes the open folder.
workspace.trust: Menu item. Trusting a folder allows its scripts, OAuth settings and file reads to run.
workspace.reveal: Menu item that shows the folder in the system file manager (Explorer, Finder).
workspace.forget: Removes the folder from the list; the files stay on disk.
workspace.problems: Menu item shown when some files in the folder could not be read.
workspace.diskReloaded: Notice shown after files were changed by another program and reloaded.
workspace.diskReloadedWithProblems: Same, with a count of files that could not be parsed.
workspace.diskChanged: Banner above a request whose file was modified on disk while the user was editing it.
workspace.vanished: Banner above a request whose file no longer exists.
workspace.keepMine: Button on that banner: keep the edits that are in the editor.
workspace.loadTheirs: Button on that banner: replace the editor content with the file content.
storageActions.cloneMessage: Prompt text. The user first types the address of a Git repository, then picks a folder.
storageActions.cloneConfirm: Confirm button of the clone prompt; the next step is picking a folder.
storageActions.trustMessage: {{example}} is the literal placeholder syntax and stays unchanged.
storageActions.problemAtLine: One line of a list of files that could not be read: path, line number, reason.
workspace.pickFolderTitle: Title of the system dialog that asks for a folder, shown when opening or creating a workspace folder or choosing where to clone to.
workspace.pin: Menu item that keeps a workspace folder at the top of the list. Verb.
workspace.rename: Menu item that renames a workspace. Verb.
workspace.forgetConfirm: Confirm button that removes a folder from the list of recent workspaces. The folder itself is not deleted.
